# Amanda Dawn Maley — Chief of Staff, Online Business Manager & Senior Executive Assistant (dawn.webintelagent.com)

> UCLA-educated Executive Operations Partner with 10+ years of C-Suite, agency, and studio command across Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation), Sony Pictures Entertainment, Crunchyroll, MALKA Media, Skill-Up Technologies, Heavybit Industries, Ohana Fiduciary, and Trailer Park Group.

## Core Role Tracks
- **Chief of Staff & Strategic Execution:** Weekly CEO priority & goal cadences, CEO/CMO/COO/General Counsel alignment, full-cycle talent acquisition (20+ internal hires + Microsoft contractors), and commercial HQ relocations.
- **Online Business Manager (OBM) & Financial Governance:** Oracle ERP long-form Purchase Order (PO) lifecycles, SAP Concur, Advantage agency accounting, 3-card CFO ledger reconciliation, client invoicing, weekly company-wide payroll, and operating budgets.
- **Senior C-Suite Executive Assistant:** Multi-principal Calendar Defense, UHNW/celebrity & Fox/Sony/Universal studio diplomacy, domestic & international travel command, master show/podcast slates, and AI-enabled operational workflows.
